parent_sample: 2MRS table3 (VizieR J/ApJS/199/26; Huchra et al. 2012), 500 < cz < 10000 km/s, |b| > 15 deg
quasar_definition: Milliquas v7.2 confirmed classes Q, A, B, K (same definition as step_22); matches closer than 3 arcsec removed as the parent's own AGN entry.

active_host_subset.definition: parent galaxies self-identified in Milliquas as confirmed quasar-class objects (Seyfert-class hosts); companion counts exclude the <3 arcsec self-match

pairing_signature.criterion: two confirmed quasars within 180 arcsec, folded PA difference >= 135 deg, |dz| <= 0.1

method: Predefined parent sample (2MRS, cz and |b| cuts only; no reference to the Arp catalogue) bulk cross-matched to confirmed Milliquas quasars via CDS XMatch at 180 arcsec; 4 seeded 1.5-deg offset controls per galaxy cross-matched identically. Overdensity per annulus with per-field count-variance propagation; paired galaxy-vs-own-controls difference tested by galaxy-unit bootstrap, Fisher-combined per-galaxy empirical tails, and a paired Wilcoxon test.
